label: LLM Tool
description: Declare one tool the model may call: a name, what it does, and a JSON Schema for its arguments. Wire it (or a list of them) into an LLM node's tools input; the model's calls come out on that node's toolCalls output, and a Chat Message node (role: tool) feeds each result back into the history.

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: Description
inputs.placeholder: Get the current weather for a city
inputs.description: What the tool does, written for the model: this is how it decides when to call it.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Arguments schema
inputs.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments. Leave empty for a tool that takes none.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: The tool declaration: wire it into an LLM node's tools input.
